title: 'susi keys add <key>' infers the vendor from the key
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Recognise sk-ant-, sk-or-, gsk_, xai-, fw_, cog_ and the other vendor prefixes and register the right env name and endpoint; ambiguous keys are verified with a read-only /models call. Tests zc_key_autodetect_*.
